policy: GPU L2 logistic regression, full-batch float64. Total weights target/name/ordinary 1/2,1/4,1/4; give half the ordinary weight to LibriSpeech when included. Give views of a source equal total weight within its group. Fit on four of five training-voice folds. Set each threshold to recover the old number of positive training views in out-of-fold scores, then refit all admitted training voices. Decisions use unrounded coefficients.
